newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Nutricia, Friesland call off talks.
newsitem.headline: Nutricia, Friesland call off talks.

text.p: Food group Nutricia NV said on Friday it and Friesland Dairy Foods Holding NV had decided to call off talks aimed at combining or swapping some of their activities.
The companies said in a statement they could not reach agreement on essential elements of a possible deal.
The companies said last year that they would start a study on combining or swapping a number of activities.

The study looked at a possible cooperation in consumer products in the Netherlands and Belgium as well as swaps of production and marketing of dairy products from Nutricia to Friesland in Germany, Poland, the Czech Republic and Hungary. The possible transfer of Friesland's baby food operations to Nutricia had also been set aside.
The companies said the talks had been cordial and the differences between the companies would have no impact on the business relations between them.
